42a2.name: WAIT-FRAMES
42a2.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Loops until Atari RTCLOK low byte $14 changes, once per requested frame.

504c.name: JOYSTICK-TRIGGER
504c.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Reads Atari hardware trigger $D010 plus the joystick number and masks bit zero; zero means pressed.

50b2.name: JOYSTICK-DELTA
50b2.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Reads STICK0 at $0278 plus joystick index, subtracts five, and maps through two direction tables.

48f0.name: INSTALL-DISPLAY
48f0.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Installs text screen address at SAVMSC $0058, stores the graphics base, and writes SDLSTL $0230.

488a.name: GRAPHICS-BASE
488a.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Receives the graphics address from INSTALL-DISPLAY and is used by graphics memory operations.

5e44.name: SAVED-DMA-CONTROL
5e44.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Receives the previous Atari SDMCTL $022F value before display DMA is disabled.

5e4e.name: DISPLAY-OFF
5e4e.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Saves SDMCTL $022F and writes zero to disable display DMA.

5e6a.name: RESTORE-DISPLAY
5e6a.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Restores the saved value of SDMCTL $022F.

6dc9.name: WAIT-KEY-OR-FIRE
6dc9.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Clears CH $02FC to $FF and waits until a keycode appears or joystick trigger zero is pressed.

6e80.name: FLASH-BACKGROUND
6e80.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Saves COLOR4 $02C8, writes color $0E for three frames, then restores the previous value.

8500.name: PRINT-CENTERED-TITLE-TEXT
8500.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Centers a counted text object around column 20, sets cursor position, and prints it with STYPE.

8612.name: SETUP-TITLE-TEXT
8612.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Sets SAVMSC relative to title-text storage, resets the title row offset, and prints cursor controls.

82f0.name: SAVED-DICTIONARY-STATE
82f0.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Two cells hold the dictionary end and latest header restored by RESTORE-DICTIONARY-LIMITS.

8312.name: RESTORE-DICTIONARY-LIMITS
8312.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Restores DP and cold-start origin fields 28, 30 and 12 from SAVED-DICTIONARY-STATE.

8382.name: TITLE-SKIP-FLAG
8382.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Initially zero; title input sets it on trigger press and title animation loops test it to exit.

838c.name: POLL-TITLE-FIRE
838c.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Clears attract mode at $4D, checks joystick fire, sets the title skip flag, and stops audio.

83b7.name: WAIT-TITLE-FRAMES
83b7.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Waits frame-by-frame while polling title fire and exits early when TITLE-SKIP-FLAG is set.

86ee.name: RUN-TITLE-PAGES
86ee.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Cycles seven animated title text pages until TITLE-SKIP-FLAG is set.

871d.name: BOOT-TITLE-AND-GAME
871d.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Boot entry loads title resources, runs title pages, restores dictionary limits and enters GAME-MAIN-LOOP.

8460.name: LOAD-TITLE-ASSETS
8460.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Performs title disk loading with an error branch, installs picture resources, and selects the title font.

5fd1.name: INITIALIZE-GAME-DISPLAY
5fd1.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Disables the display, installs game display resources and font at $BC00, initializes audio, then restores DMA.

6cbd.name: GAME-MAIN-LOOP
6cbd.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Initializes the game display and enters the persistent input, update and action loops called after the title.

3e66.name: INSTALL-GAME-VBI
3e66.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Native SETVBV call at $E45C installs the game interrupt entry $3E2D with selector six.

3e83.name: RESTORE-OS-VBI
3e83.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Native SETVBV call restores the operating system VBI entry $E45F with selector six.

5e81.name: INITIALIZE-AUDIO
5e81.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Native routine passes the audio data address and initialization selector to the embedded player entry $3003.

5ed6.name: STOP-AUDIO
5ed6.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Native call to embedded player $3003 with selector $40; called when the title is skipped.

5ec2.name: SELECT-AUDIO-SEQUENCE
5ec2.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Stores the requested audio sequence then invokes the embedded player via the adjacent native helper.

421c.name: LAST-DISK-STATUS
421c.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Receives the result of the DIRL/DSL disk operation and is checked by title and game loading paths.

858c.name: TITLE-ROW-OFFSET
858c.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Row offset added while laying out title text lines; initialized and adjusted by title page animation.

8596.name: TITLE-PAGE-LINE-COUNT
8596.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Receives the current title page text count and controls the forward and reverse line-animation loops.
